listing.publicRemarks: Beautifully maintained, four-bedroom home tucked away at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac on an oversized lot with a gorgeous diving pool! Step inside to a spacious living room with soaring vaulted ceilings, complemented by an adjoining formal dining area. The generous kitchen offers abundant cabinetry and storage along with a large breakfast area overlooking the backyard. Just off the kitchen, a short hallway leads to an oversized laundry room with plenty of space for an additional refrigerator and a freezer, as well as a convenient powder bath. At the end of the hall, discover an expansive and versatile den featuring a wet bar, built-in desks, and extensive built-in storage—an ideal space for entertaining, a game room, home office, or combination of all three. The primary suite is conveniently located downstairs and features an ensuite bath with dual vanities, a jetted tub, separate shower, and spacious walk-in closet. Upstairs are three additional bedrooms, a secondary bath with dual vanities, and convenient walk-out attic access providing excellent storage. Outside, the oversized backyard offers the best of both worlds with plenty of grassy space plus a large diving pool with an iron safety fence. With its flexible living spaces, abundant storage, generous lot, and inviting backyard, this home offers plenty of room to live, work, entertain, and enjoy.
